items.title: Liquid Glass pane banners
items.text: Sticky pane banners now render as a floating Liquid Glass card that tints to match the pane background, with a soft elliptical sheen and a cleaner shade. Collapse/expand is instant and geometry stays stable, so the terminal content below shifts once instead of jittering.

items.title: `ghoztty +reload`
items.text: Refresh a viewer pane in place without closing and reopening it. Website viewers re-fetch from origin (bypassing caches); file viewers re-render while preserving scroll position.

items.title: No more duplicate window names
items.text: Auto-generated `window-N` target names are never minted twice, so scripted windows stay uniquely addressable.
